name: Evidence Desk
description: Compare AI/ML research papers with findings traced to a source, page and exact quotation.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Read-only. Reports which Evidence Desk project this chat is bound to and what it holds: PDFs uploaded to inbox/, registered source ids, evidence and export files, and whether desk.json is valid. Works only in a chat inside an Evidence Desk project; the project is determined from the chat, so it takes no arguments.

tools.name: add_source
tools.description: Register one PDF the owner uploaded to this project's inbox/ as a source (S1, S2, ...). Extracts the text of every page so quotations can be checked. The same PDF is registered only once. Works only in a chat inside an Evidence Desk project; the project is determined from the chat.

file.description: Project path of the PDF inside inbox/, for example inbox/paper.pdf.

tools.name: check_evidence
tools.description: Read-only. Validates every evidence/S<n>.json file and checks each quotation against the registered page text of its source, on the page it cites: finding evidence, both sides of contradictions, and measurement values and compatibility fields. Also reports measurement problems: a value not in its quotation, field words not in their quotation, a unit mismatch, a difference or ratio recorded as a value, or missing hardware for speed or training cost. Matching is exact after normalizing PDF extraction artefacts; nothing is fuzzy-matched. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: export_comparison
tools.description: Write exports/comparison.csv, exports/comparison-by-dimension.csv (the same cells, one row per source and dimension, easier on a narrow screen) and exports/comparison.html for the sources in desk.json compare_sources (all registered sources if empty). The CSV has status, finding, evidence, quotation check, note, checked absences and contradictions for each of the six dimensions; the HTML is the same evidence as a citation-linked matrix plus a Reported measurements table, with dot plots only where every compatibility field matches across sources and is quote-backed. Refuses while an in-scope evidence file is invalid. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description: Read-only. Search arXiv for papers matching every word of the query and return up to 10 records: arXiv id and version, title, authors, abstract, categories, dates, journal reference, DOI if the authors gave one, and the canonical abstract page. Shows which results are already in this project's library. Results are bibliographic metadata for discovery, never evidence. Works only in an Evidence Desk project chat.

tools.name: lookup_reference
tools.description: Read-only. Look up one arXiv record by arXiv id (1706.03762, 1706.03762v7, hep-th/9901001), arXiv: id, arxiv.org/abs/ address (read as text, never fetched) or arXiv DOI (10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762). Publisher DOIs are not supported yet. Returns bibliographic metadata, never evidence.

identifier.description: An arXiv identifier or arXiv DOI.

tools.name: save_reference
tools.description: Save one arXiv record to this project's reference library (library/references.json), only after the owner explicitly chose that paper. The service fetches the record from arXiv itself and stores it with provenance; duplicates are not saved twice. A library record is discovery metadata, not evidence, and no PDF is downloaded: to use a paper, the owner uploads its PDF to inbox/ and it is registered with add_source.

identifier.description: The arXiv identifier the owner chose.

project_templates.name: Paper comparison
project_templates.description: Compare research papers on six dimensions, with every finding traced to a page and exact quotation.
project_templates.guidance: Evidence Desk project. Read the evidence-desk skill before working. inbox/ holds the owner's uploads: read only. sources/ and exports/ are written only by Evidence Desk tools: never edit them. You write evidence/, desk.json and synthesis.md. A Reported finding needs a source id, page and exact quotation; otherwise it is Not reported (checked and absent) or Not assessed. Never invent findings. The Evidence comparison Creation and exports/comparison.html show the evidence as a citation-linked matrix; never present values from different papers as directly comparable. search_literature and lookup_reference find arXiv papers; save_reference adds an owner-selected paper to library/, which only Evidence Desk writes. Library metadata is never evidence. The owner adds PDFs by opening inbox/ in the project file list and choosing Upload; you cannot upload, so if inbox/ has no PDFs, say so. Call synthesis.md the research summary; desk.json and README.md are support files. Write the summary briefly, in plain English: lead with a short answer to the research question, keep sentences short, explain each technical term in a few words the first time you use it, and keep every [S1 p.5] citation and Not reported / Not assessed statement.

actions.name: Check project setup
actions.prompt: Call the Evidence Desk project_status tool and tell me what it reports: which project this chat is bound to, which papers are in inbox/, and anything that needs my attention. Do not change any files.

actions.name: Plan a comparison
actions.prompt: Help me set up this paper comparison. Read desk.json and project_status first, then ask me for the research question and the papers in scope before you edit desk.json. Do not record any findings yet.

actions.name: Find papers
actions.prompt: Find papers on arXiv about this topic: [describe the topic here]. Use search_literature and show me the titles, authors, years and arXiv ids. Use save_reference only for the papers I choose. Library records are metadata, not evidence: do not download PDFs and do not record findings from abstracts.

actions.name: Register PDFs and check evidence
actions.prompt: Register the PDFs I uploaded to inbox/ with add_source and list the sources. Then run check_evidence and report every failed quotation and every dimension that is still Not assessed. Fix a quotation only by re-reading its source page. Never invent findings and never loosen a quotation to make it pass.

actions.name: Export and review the comparison
actions.prompt: Run check_evidence. If no evidence file is invalid, run export_comparison. Then summarize what the comparison shows and which measurements were not plotted, with the reason for each. Plot or compare measurements only when every comparison requirement is met. Tell me to open the Evidence comparison view or exports/comparison.html.
